name: Doki Doki v Alice Panic!
original_name: ドキドキvアリスパニック!
source:
That was the miracle of love that swept down from above...

You are the White Rabbit that attends to the needs of the Heart Country. It may be an ordinary life, but surrounded by your companions, your days are splendid.

Then one day, a mysterious young man fell from the sky?!

This is an original Katekyo Hitman Reborn AU based on "Alice in Wonderland"! It overflows with the miracles of love!

[Translation of [URL=http://www.stellaworth.co.jp/shop/item.php?item_id=9is202s95sZ]Stellaworth's product information[/URL].]
translation:
那是从天而降的爱的奇迹……

你是满足心之国需要的白兔。生活也许很平凡，但有同伴在身边，日子就很灿烂。

然后有一天，一名神秘青年从天而降？！

这是根据《爱丽丝梦游仙境》改编的原创家庭教师杀手重生AU！它充满了爱的奇迹！

[翻译][URL=http://www.stellaworth.co.jp/shop/item.php?item_id=9is202s95sZ]斯特拉沃斯的产品信息[/URL].]
